description: Public, works on any plan. Returns a tipster's verified record by handle (the name in prop-line.com/record/{handle}): all_time and last_30_days with picks, won, lost, push_or_void, win_pct, units_staked, units_profit and roi_pct, plus each graded pick. Every pick was logged with PropLine before its game started, at a price no better than the best price a tracked sportsbook was showing, cannot be edited or deleted, and was graded against official stats. pending = picks awaiting a result; not_yet_started = picks hidden until their game starts. Use it to check a tipster's claimed record. Report the numbers as they are: a small sample (under ~100 picks) says little, and a past record does not predict future results. A 404 means no such record.
name: propline_get_verified_record
title: A tipster's verified betting record
